title: Forecast Encompassing：GJR 完全包含 GARCH（SPY），反之不成立
description:
## Forecast Encompassing Test（SPY 2023-2024）

RV_t = α + β₁ σ²_GJR + β₂ σ²_GARCH + ε_t

| 檢定 | β_other | p-value | 結論 |
|------|---------|---------|------|
| GJR encompasses GARCH? | β_GARCH = -0.61 | 0.062 | ✓ GJR 包含 GARCH |
| GARCH encompasses GJR? | β_GJR = +1.11 | 0.001 | ✗ GARCH 不包含 GJR |

GJR 的 asymmetry (γ) 參數提供了 GARCH 無法複製的額外預測信息。

## Forecast Encompassing Test（SPY 2023-2024）

RV_t = \alpha + \beta_1 \sigma^2_GJR + \beta₂ \sigma^2_GARCH + \epsilon_t

| 檢定 | \beta_other | p-value | 結論 |
|------|---------|---------|------|
| GJR encompasses GARCH? | \beta_GARCH = -0.61 | 0.062 | ✓ GJR 包含 GARCH |
| GARCH encompasses GJR? | \beta_GJR = +1.11 | 0.001 | ✗ GARCH 不包含 GJR |
